title: Mapped list reconstruction from indexed values
statement: Let $l$ be a list of natural numbers of length $m$, and let $f$ map natural numbers to Booleans. The list obtained by applying $f$ to the entries of $l$ is the list of values $f(l_i)$ for indices $i=0,\\ldots,m-1$, where each entry is read with default value $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a list of natural numbers
